simple.meaning: a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זִמְרָה (H2172) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: זִמְרָה (zimrâh) means a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument First listed occurrence: Amos 5 23.
